name: National MILO Marathon 2026 – Cebu Leg
short_description: The National MILO Marathon 2026 – Cebu Leg was a half marathon with 10 km, 5 km and 3 km races, run on 6 September 2026 from Gatewalk Central in Mandaue City, Cebu, Philippines.
ai_summary: The National MILO Marathon 2026 – Cebu Leg was run on Sunday 6 September 2026 at Gatewalk Central in Mandaue City, Cebu, Philippines. RUNRIO Inc. organised it for MILO as part of the 50th National MILO Marathon. It offered 21.1 km, 10 km, 5 km and 3 km races, with the 21.1 km half marathon as the qualifying race for the National Finals.
pros: Cheap entry: P1,799 for the 21 km and P499 for the 3 km in 2026
A route to the National Finals marathon: 21 km winners get an all-expenses place, and age-group qualifying times
Small 21 km field: 170 listed in 2026, with tenth place at 1:32 (men) and 2:20 (women)
Full 21 km and 10 km results with gun and chip times
21 km finishers get a medal, shirt, cap and loot bag
cons: Tight cut-offs: 2 hours 30 for the 21 km, with a 90-minute check at 10 km
Hot, wet air before dawn: 27°C to 28°C with a 24°C dew point in 2026
The 2026 race ran in haze rated unhealthy for sensitive groups
No route map, start times or aid-station plan on the 2026 race pages
Top-ten finishers are barred from later MILO races that season
research_highlights: The Cebu leg has historically been one of the largest regional legs in the whole Milo Marathon series, with a record field of over 24,000 runners in 2019 and over 16,000 in 2024
The 2026 leg, part of the 50th National MILO Marathon, drew 10,000 registered runners to Gatewalk Central in Mandaue City, with the start and finish at the same point.
2026 cut-offs were 2 hours 30 for the 21K, with a 1 hour 30 check at 10K, 2 hours for the 10K and 1 hour each for the 5K and 3K.
Local organizing has often involved Cebuano Olympian and six-time Milo Marathon champion Mary Joy Tabal, who has helped run the leg with RUNRIO and local city governments
Categories in recent Cebu-area editions have included 21K, 10K, 5K and 3K, with the 5K typically drawing the largest number of entrants
research_watchouts: Heat has been noted as a factor by organizers even with early morning start times ('a little bit hot')

The Cebu leg's host venue is not fixed: the 2026 leg was held at Gatewalk Central in Mandaue City, although the Race Roster event page gave the address only as Cebu City, so the start location should be checked for each edition.

faqs.question: When was the National MILO Marathon 2026 – Cebu Leg?
faqs.answer: The National MILO Marathon 2026 – Cebu Leg was run on Sunday 6 September 2026. It started and finished at Gatewalk Central in Mandaue City, Cebu, as part of the 50th National MILO Marathon. The race went ahead despite haze over Metro Cebu from wildfires in Indonesia.

faqs.question: What distances were offered at the 2026 Cebu leg?
faqs.answer: The 2026 Cebu leg offered four distances: the 21.1 km half marathon, a 10 km, a 5 km (with a family category) and a 3 km. The half marathon was the main race and a qualifier for the National Finals marathon in Clark in December. No 1 km race was held.

faqs.question: Who organised the National MILO Marathon 2026 – Cebu Leg?
faqs.answer: RUNRIO Inc. organised the 2026 Cebu leg for MILO as one of 15 races in the National MILO Marathon series, with Joel Juarez as local race director. The leg was held in Mandaue City, not Cebu City, with the start and finish at Gatewalk Central.
